1.consolidated_definition: Bebida famosa de Nueva Orleans que consiste en la combina- ción de ginebra, limón, azúcar, clara de huevo y soda. Anglicismo crudo, poco frecuente. DRAE 2001, voz inglesa. El gin fizz es el más conocido de la familia de cocteles denominados Fizz. Es similar al Tom Collins, la diferencia radica en que este último, historicamente se prepara con Old Tom Gin, precursor del London Dry Gin, y se sirve en un vaso más grande y con hielo (Recetas.com, consultado 24-04-08)
1.en_consolidated_definition: Famous New Orleans beverage consisting of a combination of gin, lemon, sugar, egg white, and soda water. Raw Anglicism, infrequently used. DRAE 2001, English voice. The Gin Fizz is the most well-known member of the family of cocktails known as Fizz. It is similar to the Tom Collins, with the difference lying in the fact that the latter historically is prepared with Old Tom Gin, precursor to London Dry Gin, and served in a larger glass with ice (Recetas.com, consulted 24-04-08).
